versions.content: No execution of mode disabling dependent Exe- cutableEntitys during synchronous mode switch Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00143, SRS_Rte_00213, SRS_Rte_00018 The RTE generator shall reject configurations that, for a synchronous mode switch, allow the execution of mode disabling dependent Ex- ecutableEntitys after core local mode user group on-exit Exe- cutableEntitys of that mode machine instance have started to execute and before all core local mode user group on-entry ExecutableEn- titys of the same mode machine instance have terminated.
